title: The Wall of Winnipeg and Me
author: Mariana Zapata
summary: Vanessa is the personal assistant of a gruff professional football player with a famous reputation for blocking. When he gets a surprising career break, their working relationship slowly changes.
readIf: you like long, slow-burn romances with a lot of humour and everyday detail.
skipIf: you want a quick, high-drama love story that gets to the point.
